# three-mesh-bvh 0.9.14

Local, MIT-licensed raycast acceleration for the controller's exact mesh surfaces.
Source: https://github.com/gkjohnson/three-mesh-bvh, npm `three-mesh-bvh@0.9.14`.
The peer requirement is Three.js >= 0.159.0; this project uses 0.180.0.

`index.module.min.js` is the package's `build/index.module.js`, minified with
`esbuild@0.25.9 --minify --format=esm`. The external `three` import resolves to
the project's existing local Three.js through its import map. No CDN is needed.
The original license is included alongside the module.
